messages.text: How do changes in automotive radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Vector Network Analyzer?

### Short answer
The passages do not directly state a historical “change → VNA requirement” rule, but they show that automotive radar test cases span 24 GHz / 24–44 GHz / 76–81 GHz bands, wider IF/RF bandwidths up to 5 GHz IF or 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth, Doppler/velocity functions, and VNA-based time-domain / transfer-characteristic measurements, so the VNA capability pressure shifts toward mmWave frequency reach, swept wide-span characterization, time-domain analysis, dynamic range/noise performance, and amplitude/group-delay flatness measurement [52][50][46][11][12][48].
### Supported facts
- Automotive radar echo generation in the passages covers RF bands including 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, 24 GHz to 44 GHz, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz [52].  
- The R&S QAT100 with AREG800A is specified for 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, with 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth [50].  
- The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is listed as 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option, with overrange values of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz, and 5.2 GHz [52].  
- VNA-based AREG800A IF transfer measurements use frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [12].  
- VNA-based ghost-object suppression measurements use a vector network analyzer in time domain with frequency step size 125 kHz, measurement bandwidth 100 kHz, source power –10 dBm, distance to wanted artificial object 2 m, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [11].  
- RF transfer-characteristic measurements for AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D use frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, and measure from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector [48].  
- Those RF transfer-characteristic measurements include amplitude flatness limits of < ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth, plus group delay flatness limits of < ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth and < ±1 ns in 2 GHz or 4 GHz bandwidth [48].  
- Automotive radar echo generation also includes individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h, velocity step size 0.001 km/h, Doppler frequency offset accuracy < 1 Hz in the IF domain, and velocity accuracy < 0.05 km/h for 78 GHz or 79 GHz center frequency cases [46].  
- The R&S ZNA series covers models up to 67 GHz, with measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz on the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [9].  
- The R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz, with 1 Hz frequency resolution and 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidths [56][59].  
- The R&S ZNA key performance data include dynamic range > 129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [4].  
- The R&S ZNA supports mmWave converter use through optional rear-panel LO out, with up to four converters on a 4-port model or two converters on a 2-port model, without an external signal generator [32].  
### Inference
- 【推論】Because the automotive radar passages include 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar/front-end cases while the base R&S ZNA67 stops at 67 GHz, VNA measurement for those radar RF paths would need either a VNA system that reaches above 81 GHz, such as the R&S ZNA67EXT at 10 MHz to 110 GHz, or an mmWave-converter-based setup where applicable [52][50][9][56][32].  
- 【推論】Because the automotive radar echo-generator passages specify 1 GHz, 2 GHz, 4 GHz, and 5 GHz-class IF/RF bandwidth contexts, the VNA need is not just a narrow spot measurement but swept characterization over GHz-class spans with defined frequency step size, measurement bandwidth, amplitude flatness, and group delay flatness conditions [52][50][12][48].  
- 【推論】Because ghost-object suppression is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain and dynamic RCS / transfer measurements are specified with source power, measurement bandwidth, and frequency-step conditions, automotive radar technology that adds artificial objects, Doppler, and ghost-object constraints increases the need for VNA time-domain, calibrated wide-span, and high-dynamic-range measurement capability [11][12][46][4].

- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S ZNA]] — Vector Network Analyzer 系列，涵蓋 26.5 GHz、43.5 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz 型號。
- [[R&S ZNA26]] — 26.5 GHz 型號，3.5 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA43]] — 43.5 GHz 型號，2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA50]] — 50 GHz 型號，2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA67]] — 67 GHz 型號，1.85 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[Vector Network Analyzer]]、[[Dynamic range]]、[[Measurement bandwidth]]、[[Direct source and receiver access]]、[[Noise figure measurement]]、[[mmWave converter support]]、[[Phase-coherent source control]]、[[Health and utilization monitoring service]]、[[Time domain analysis]]、[[Deembedding]]。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。

passages.text:
電信技術中心 › 毫米波測試量能
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]介紹電信技術中心毫米波頻段測試量能：

- 5G FR2 毫米波天線縮距量測場 CATR。
- 來源稱該 chamber 依據 3GPP 技術規範標準，已通過 TAF 認證。
- 支援主波發射頻段 3–40 GHz。
- 不必要發射可至 90 GHz。
- 可量測 TRP、TIS、EVM。
- Quiet Zone 可達 90 cm。

R&S PCB test solutions
[[R&S PCB test solutions]] 是 [[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]] Slide 21 對 PCB Fabricator and System House 的 PCB / high-speed digital 測試流程摘要，涵蓋 material measurement、stackup selection、signal integrity modeling/testing、sampling testing 與 process monitoring。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

欣銓 › 來源中的說法
- [[Power IC - Power Management IC]] 在功率半導體封測區塊將 [[欣銓]] 寫為「車用與功率IC測試核心廠」。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S ZNB3020
[[R&S ZNB3020]] 是 [[R&S ZNB3000]] 系列的 20 GHz Vector Network Analyzer 型號，依 Version 09.00（July 2026）base frequency range 為 9 kHz to 20.0 GHz，搭配 frequency upgrade option 可到 26.5 GHz。

R&S ZNA26 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA26]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

| Output level repeatability | 1 h warm-up 後 typ. < 0.2 dB |

EVM 條件：SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz、64QAM、+15 °C to +35 °C、within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment。來源標示 EVM 為 measured values。

### Short answer
The passages do not directly state a historical “change → VNA requirement” rule, but they show that automotive radar test cases span 24 GHz / 24–44 GHz / 76–81 GHz bands, wider IF/RF bandwidths up to 5 GHz IF or 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth, Doppler/velocity functions, and VNA-based time-domain / transfer-characteristic measurements, so the VNA capability pressure shifts toward mmWave frequency reach, swept wide-span characterization, time-domain analysis, dynamic range/noise performance, and amplitude/group-delay flatness measurement [52][50][46][11][12][48].
### Supported facts
- Automotive radar echo generation in the passages covers RF bands including 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, 24 GHz to 44 GHz, and 76 GHz to 81 GHz [52].  
- The R&S QAT100 with AREG800A is specified for 76 GHz to 77 GHz and 77 GHz to 81 GHz, with 4 GHz RF instantaneous bandwidth [50].  
- The AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is listed as 1 GHz, 2 GHz, or 5 GHz depending on option, with overrange values of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz, and 5.2 GHz [52].  
- VNA-based AREG800A IF transfer measurements use frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, source power –10 dBm, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz depending on bandwidth [12].  
- VNA-based ghost-object suppression measurements use a vector network analyzer in time domain with frequency step size 125 kHz, measurement bandwidth 100 kHz, source power –10 dBm, distance to wanted artificial object 2 m, and spans of 1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz, 0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz, or 0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz [11].  
- RF transfer-characteristic measurements for AREG8-81S / AREG8-81D use frequency step size 2.5 MHz, measurement bandwidth 1 kHz, and measure from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector [48].  
- Those RF transfer-characteristic measurements include amplitude flatness limits of < ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth, < ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth, and < ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth, plus group delay flatness limits of < ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth and < ±1 ns in 2 GHz or 4 GHz bandwidth [48].  
- Automotive radar echo generation also includes individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h, velocity step size 0.001 km/h, Doppler frequency offset accuracy < 1 Hz in the IF domain, and velocity accuracy < 0.05 km/h for 78 GHz or 79 GHz center frequency cases [46].  
- The R&S ZNA series covers models up to 67 GHz, with measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz on the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with the R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [9].  
- The R&S ZNA67EXT is a 1.0 mm VNA system covering 10 MHz to 110 GHz, with 1 Hz frequency resolution and 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz measurement bandwidths [56][59].  
- The R&S ZNA key performance data include dynamic range > 129 dB without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [4].  
- The R&S ZNA supports mmWave converter use through optional rear-panel LO out, with up to four converters on a 4-port model or two converters on a 2-port model, without an external signal generator [32].  
### Inference
- 【推論】Because the automotive radar passages include 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar/front-end cases while the base R&S ZNA67 stops at 67 GHz, VNA measurement for those radar RF paths would need either a VNA system that reaches above 81 GHz, such as the R&S ZNA67EXT at 10 MHz to 110 GHz, or an mmWave-converter-based setup where applicable [52][50][9][56][32].  
- 【推論】Because the automotive radar echo-generator passages specify 1 GHz, 2 GHz, 4 GHz, and 5 GHz-class IF/RF bandwidth contexts, the VNA need is not just a narrow spot measurement but swept characterization over GHz-class spans with defined frequency step size, measurement bandwidth, amplitude flatness, and group delay flatness conditions [52][50][12][48].  
- 【推論】Because ghost-object suppression is measured with a vector network analyzer in time domain and dynamic RCS / transfer measurements are specified with source power, measurement bandwidth, and frequency-step conditions, automotive radar technology that adds artificial objects, Doppler, and ghost-object constraints increases the need for VNA time-domain, calibrated wide-span, and high-dynamic-range measurement capability [11][12][46][4].
